messages:
julia: Heads-up: small hotfix prepared for a serializer crash in prod on long inputs (>300 tokens). Patch image `redwood/serving:2.7.1-hotfix`. No schema or client changes. Asking for a short midnight window (00:00-00:30 UTC). Plan: smoke -> 2% canary -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-rollback if 5xx rate > 0.4% over 2m OR p95 latency > 700ms for 3m. No DB migrations.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued by @julia
- image: `redwood/serving:2.7.1-hotfix`
- targets: eu-west1,multi-tenant-pool
- strategy: staged canary (2% -> 25% -> 100%)
- smoke job: `smoke/serializer-long-input` (600-token run)

marco: quick Q: will dedicated tenants be impacted by the canary? We usually pin them for hotfixes.

julia: dedicated pools will remain pinned to 2.7.0 during the canary. Only multi-tenant pool receives the canary. I'll add the pin/unpin commands to the PR.

ops-bot: Paging oncall: @rachel  please ack within 5m to avoid auto-escalation.

rachel: ack. I'll monitor metrics and be ready to trigger rollback.

ivan: I can +1 expedited if rollback probe is automated and runbook exists. Please add release-note blurb.

julia: rollback webhook wired. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serializer-hotfix-2-7-1. release note draft: "2.7.1-hotfix: fix serializer crash on long inputs that caused occasional 5xx. No client changes." adding to PR now.

marco: add a short post-deploy checklist in PR for support (how to detect regression + contact channel).

julia: added support checklist and contact: #support-hotfixes. Also included command to pin dedicated pools: `/pin --image redwood/serving:2.7.0 --pools dedicated-*`.

ivan: :+1: from me. ops oncall acknowledged.

deploy-bot: Scheduling deploy window: start 3501234600 -> smoke then canary 2%. CLI preview:

```
/deploy --image redwood/serving:2.7.1-hotfix \
  --targets eu-west1,multi-tenant-pool \
  --strategy canary --canary-percent 2 --canary-duration 10m \
  --follow-ups "25% in 5m if green, 100% in 10m" \
  --smoke smoke/serializer-long-input --rollback-probe "5xx>0.4||p95>700" \
  --pin-dedicated "redwood/serving:2.7.0"
```

julia: kicking smoke now, will post results in ~90s.

(90s later)
julia: smoke clean  no errors, p95 stable. starting 2% canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 2% at 3501234625. Observability hooks active.

rachel: monitoring traces and SLO dashboards. no anomalies yet.

(7m later)
julia: ramping to 25% per expedited approval. will monitor 10m then proceed to 100% if green.

(12m later)
deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% initiated at 3501234670 per owner instruction. Dedicated pools still pinned.

julia: ramp complete, 100% on 2.7.1-hotfix. Monitoring window 30m. Thanks all for quick turnaround :rocket:

ivan: thanks, please leave final post-deploy note and link to the release PR for audit.

julia: will add post-deploy summary + PR link (https://git.internal/redwood/serving/pull/789) and unpin instructions once stable.
